title: How to File for Divorce in New York (2027): Fees & Steps
rank_math_title: How to File for Divorce in New York (2027): $335 in Fees
rank_math_description: New York divorce 2027: 1- or 2-year residency, no waiting period, 6-month no-fault ground, $335 court fees, personal service, required notices.
focus_keyword: how to file for divorce in new york
pdf_outline: Checklist: residency (DRL §230 five routes) -> Summons with Notice + 3 notices -> index number $210 / poor person relief -> personal service by non-party adult within 120 days -> Affidavit of Defendant -> settlement -> Affidavit of Plaintiff (170(7) sworn) -> barriers statement if religious ceremony -> Note of Issue $30 + RJI $95 -> findings + judgment -> Notice of Entry
